item.title: Quatrième suite in A minor, Op. 1
item.description:
Philidor&rsquo;s Quatrième suite in A minor, Op. 1 is a French Baroque suite, centered on dance character and ornamented melodic writing. This version presents the distinct character and affect of each movement through the recorder.
Hsing-An Lee Recorder Recital in Hsinchu, Taiwan Recorder: Hsing-An Lee Harpsichord: Machiko Suto
